summary: A static audit of the notebook and saved outputs. It found the LinearSVC-versus-LDA mismatch, the doPCA centering bug, missing evaluation code, missing mitigated embeddings, noisy noun lists, the cell 307 slip and the attribute-list mismatches. On the High items it only partly flagged the Table 1 p-values (A1), the identical Shift/Hybrid Ori statistics (A3), the French mismatch (A4) and the MRR denominator (A5). It missed the circularity of the mitigation (A2), the masculine-only cue list and the inanimate-noun score. It gave one mild endorsement of the mitigation's directional conclusion. No MUSE vectors were downloaded. The scoping is mostly sound and locations are cell-specific, though the report mixes in post-audit replication results.
